presets.name: drawn (classic)
presets.description:
one group combining its shapes by screen (smooth union), so that
overlapping feathered edges merge without a seam; a classic drawn mask
used maximum (union)

notes: draw shapes or add AI objects here to mask an area
with union operators, the pixels covered by any of the shapes are masked
screen (smooth union), used here, lets the feathered edges of overlapping shapes blend smoothly
maximum (union) keeps the stronger shape, as a classic drawn mask did
use minimum or product to mask only the pixels covered by all shapes

presets.name: parametric (classic)
presets.description:
one group combining its parametric channels by
product (smooth intersection), as a classic parametric mask did

notes: add parametric channels here to select the area to mask, e.g. by color or brightness
with the intersection operators, only the pixels selected by all channels are masked
change the operator to some type of union to mask the pixels selected by any channel
screen and product, the smooth variants, make smoother transitions between feathered areas

presets.name: drawn + parametric (classic)
presets.description:
a "drawn" group, maximum (union), and a "parametric" group,
product (smooth intersection), combined by product (smooth
intersection), as a classic drawn + parametric mask did

notes: mask an area with parametric channels, and refine the selection with drawn shapes
start by selecting the parametric group and adding channels to it, then move on to the drawn group
with the intersection operators, only the area where the two groups overlap is masked
product (smooth intersection) lets their soft edges fade together; minimum (intersection) keeps the weaker of the two
use the difference operator to exclude the area masked by the drawn group instead
alternatively, invert the output of the drawn group

presets.name: drawn + parametric, minus an area (advanced)
presets.description:
a drawn + parametric mask, with the elements added above it subtracted
from it

notes: subtract unwanted spill from a drawn + parametric mask
start by creating a mask in the drawn + parametric group, then add elements here to remove the spill
